## 2. Core Technical Competencies & Stacks
- **Frontend Architecture**: Astro 7.2 (SSG & View Transitions), Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, daisyUI 5, Partytown Web Workers, Lenis Smooth Scroll.
- **Backend & Edge Systems**: Cloudflare Workers, Hono, Node.js, Go, Python, Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Cloudflare Turnstile, Cloudflare R2, Cloudflare KV, SQLite / D1, PostgreSQL, Redis.
- **AI & Automation Tooling**: Local Small Language Models (Google Gemma 2B Vision via LM Studio), Bun runtime zero-copy scripting, automated vision image optimization (`smart-img-cli`).
- **Quality Gates & Observability**: Sentry real-time exception telemetry, Playwright E2E browser automation, ESLint 10 flat config, Prettier, Zod runtime schema validation, zero-dependency build-time quality hooks (`astroSiteQualityEnforcer`).

## 3. Production Case Studies
1. **Enterprise Conversion Funnels & Edge API Proxies** (`@ecspl`):
   - High-throughput advertising funnels (`expertpanel.org`, `lawyerpanel.org`).
   - Secure Experian credit-report OTP verification proxies on Hono (`SendExpOtp` / `VerifyExpOtp`).
   - Dual-stream Server-Side Meta Conversions API (CAPI) routing with SHA-256 PII normalization and deterministic `event_id` deduplication.
   - Sentry exception triage eliminating Alpine.js client race conditions.

2. **smart-img-cli** (Open Source Tooling):
   - Fast CLI image compression and local vision AI SEO metadata extractor built with Bun.
   - Leverages offline Google Gemma 2B Vision running via LM Studio at $0.00 cloud cost and 100% data privacy.

3. **SoulMedia Creative Agency Platform** (`@SquadCoders`):
   - Static agency platform with dynamic Strapi CMS data layer and `sanitize-html`.
   - Automated `FAQPage` and `Service` Schema.org JSON-LD structured data.
   - Multi-stage Docker builds synchronized with Cloudflare R2 asset buckets.

4. **Hotel Akbar Sonmarg Luxury Portal** (`@SquadCoders`):
   - High-end hospitality web platform with Astro 7.2, daisyUI v5, and Tailwind CSS v4.
   - Dynamic room collections, tour booking inquiries, and build-time link verification.

5. **Rooh Yaseen Editorial Portfolio** (`@SquadCoders`):
   - High-end cinematography and photography portfolio for UK DoP Rooh Yaseen.
   - Lightweight video facades preventing third-party iframe render blocking and guaranteeing 0.00 CLS.

---

## 4. Key Engineering Philosophy
- **KISS & YAGNI**: Reject premature abstraction. Build straightforward systems with minimal moving parts.
- **Performance by Default**: Ship static HTML first; isolate interactive widgets to Astro islands; offload third-party tracking scripts to Web Workers via Partytown.
- **Tactile UI Craft**: High-contrast typography, calibrated OKLCH color spaces, zero neon fluff, and responsive micro-interactions (`scale(0.98)` on press).
- **Type Safety & Integrity**: End-to-end type safety, Zod schema validation across all content pipelines, and strict pnpm supply-chain pinning.
